description: Get everything Oura recorded for one day in a single call: readiness (score, contributors, temperature deviation), sleep score and the night's main sleep (stages, HRV, lowest heart rate, efficiency), naps, activity (score, steps, calories), stress, resilience, SpO2, cardiovascular age, VO2 max, bedtime guidance, workouts, sessions and tags. Start here for 'today', 'last night' or any single date; use get_trends for multi-day questions and the list_* tools for one data type over a range. Omit date for the latest day with a sleep or readiness score. Data types the user didn't grant are listed under `unavailable` instead of failing the call.

date.description: Day to show (YYYY-MM-DD); a night's sleep belongs to the day you woke up. Defaults to the latest day.

name: get_daily_overview
title: Daily overview
